name: GL-II-73
summary: GL-II-73 (GL-ii-073) is a benzodiazepine derivative related in chemical structure to compounds such as midazolam and adinazolam. It is described as an α5 preferring positive allosteric modulator of the benzodiazepine site of GABAA receptors, with weaker activity at α2 and α3 and no significant affinity for the α1 subtype.

pharmacology.text: It is described as an α5 preferring positive allosteric modulator of the benzodiazepine site of GABAA receptors, with weaker activity at α2 and α3 and no significant affinity for the α1 subtype.

uses.text: It is now being researched as a potential treatment agent for Alzheimer's disease.

fact.en: GL-II-73 was designed to favour GABAA receptors that contain the alpha-5 subunit, which are packed into the hippocampus, a brain area central to memory.
fact.zh: GL-II-73 被設計成偏好含有 α5 次單元的 GABAA 受體，這類受體大量分布在海馬迴，也就是與記憶密切相關的腦區。
fact.zhHans: GL-II-73 被设计成偏好含有 α5 次单元的 GABAA 受体，这类受体大量分布在海马回，也就是与记忆密切相关的脑区。
